title: 19-BCV-009 - Natural gas regulating and metering station buildings

facts.text: The variance provides an alternative occupancy classification for buildings housing natural-gas regulating and metering equipment.
Such buildings may be classified as Group F, Division 2 if they do not exceed 55 m² or one storey, are low-human-occupancy, and have sufficient ventilation to prevent small leaks accumulating.

limitations: This is a provincewide regulator-issued STANDATA variance, not an individual application, site-specific permit decision, or applicant-provided evidence.
